market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound with downward bias; banks provide floor support but housing stress and rate hike fears cap upside. AUD strength may pressure export earnings. Expect volatility around RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity deterioration and debt concerns create structural headwinds. Mining and resources remain resilient on global demand. Housing correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. Energy transition cost overruns could delay renewable capex cycles.
